messages:
Alex M: Hey team — I addressed the review comments on the request-queue PR. PTAL when you have a sec. I fixed the flaky integration test by switching to a deterministic clock and added a short retry in the background worker.

Maria G: Thanks, I can look in ~30m. Did you keep the backoff short?

Alex M: Yep — max backoff 200ms; added a comment explaining the tradeoff. Quick perf run looks neutral: +0.2% p50, -1% p95. Logs attached.

Kevin S: Quick skim: can you move that magic number into a config constant? Hard to change later.

Alex M: Good call — moved it to constants.py and exposed it behind a feature flag `rq.flaky_test_backoff_ms`. Also added a short snippet in the PR description showing the default.

Maria G: lgtm on the test fix and config move. One small nit: please add a unit test that asserts the default value so we notice accidental changes.

Alex M: Added the unit test and pushed. Also added a rollback note in the PR description in case the retry causes unexpected side effects. @ci-bot can you rerun the integration job?

ci-bot: integration-job/217 started by Alex M — queued.

Kevin S: PTAL after CI passes; if green we can merge into canary today.

Alex M: Thanks — will merge after green + a quick smoke run in staging. :thumbsup:
